IN.rule: Copyright Act 1957 s.22: life + 60 years from the year following death

US.rule: 17 U.S.C. 304 / Circular 15a: works first published before 1 January 1931 are in the public domain

GB.rule: CDPA 1988 s.12: life + 70 years from the end of the calendar year of death

BR.rule: Law 9610/1998 art.41: life + 70 years from 1 January following death

SG.rule: Copyright Act 2021 s.114: life + 70; terms already expired under the earlier life + 50 rule (before the 2004 extension) are not revived

MY.rule: Copyright Act 1987 s.17: life + 50 years from the year following death

ID.rule: Law 28/2014 art.58: life + 70 years from 1 January following death

PH.rule: IP Code s.213.1: life + 50 years from the year following death

TH.rule: Copyright Act B.E. 2537 s.19: life + 50 years from the death of the author
